## Source and scope

Canonical URL, pinned revision, lineage, and selected subsystem/sample.

## Evidence and questions

Links to issue/PR/commit/test evidence. Distinguish reports from reproductions.

## Completion criteria

- [ ] Validate access, revisions, licensing, and lineage.
- [ ] Document collection scope and exclusions.
- [ ] Trace selected reports to fixes and regression evidence.
- [ ] Extract deduplicated review questions with applicability.
- [ ] Publish evidence and limitations; do not imply unexecuted tests passed.
